CAPITAL & STRATEGIC PARTNERS

Partnership built around real assets.

Plexus welcomes conversations with organizations seeking a disciplined, project-specific approach to development and real estate.

INVESTMENT APPROACH

Alignment begins with a clear project thesis.

Each potential partnership starts with the asset, the development path and the risks that need to be understood. Plexus’s focus spans housing, commercial and strategic land opportunities in Nova Scotia, with Atlantic Canada as a wider area of interest.

Scope, role, governance, reporting and capital terms belong in private, project-specific discussions supported by diligence.
